title: Let the host app supply its own permission policy
narrative: Fangore starts the CLI host with family `pass_through` and backend `mock`. His product needs permission rules defined by the application. He declares a compound access policy in the story environment, runs `access_check`, and verifies composed packs allow read/write while denying media — bound through Config DI, not Settings bags.
implementation: `MechaHarnessConfig` hooks (`get_access_policy`, `get_access_control`, `get_grants`) bind host permission packs through pyiv injection. Story `environment.access_policy` / `grants` override those hooks; product verb `access_check` observes Config-injected `AccessControl`. Hosts also pass grants on `run_recipe(...)`.
validation: Harness `user_story` scenario `config_access_policy.yaml` drives `access_check` with environment compound policy; expects allows_compound / denies_missing.
